title: Compare declared engineering subjects
description: Observe explicit contained subjects for declared-read checks or review preparation without replacing actor expectations or inferring assessment adequacy.
inputs: Explicit contained subject paths and reported or compared basis.
outputs: Scope-limited factual comparison, explicit absence, or safe mismatch/failure.
behavior: Inspect only declared contained regular files within defined bounds.
Check supplied compared expectations against observed bytes; reported assertions remain attributable.
A mismatch cannot silently refresh expected basis, rewrite historical assessed subjects or broaden approval.
Observed checks do not lock arbitrary external engineering edits.

failure_behavior.condition: Observed state differs, changes during inspection or cannot be read safely.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return a gap or dependent-write conflict/rejection without partial state or inferred agreement.
